title: Why your AI website looks cheap
description:
Your site doesn't look cheap by accident.

Nobody gave your AI any standards.

Here's the thing about taste.

You can't prompt a feeling.

Premium isn't an instruction.

Rules are.

Now Claude has Apple's rules.

Point it at your current site.

Watch it catch the small stuff.

Spacing you stopped noticing.

It's like setting a level on a shelf.

You never saw the tilt before.

You're not copying Apple's look.

You're borrowing the rules underneath it.

Run the audit and see what's off.

#apple #claude #claudeskills #website #design
